method: Public HTTPS pages were opened in a browser-equivalent fetch. Chapter titles were parsed from the T2026-2 HTML index. No page required a login. CARM, broker portals, and paid WCO texts were not used.

sources.title: CBSA Customs Tariff publication
authoritative_for: Which departmental-consolidation edition the CBSA is publishing
Links to chapter HTML, PDF, and Access files
not_authoritative_for: A developer API of duty rates
sources.notes: Menu listed T2026-2 effective 2026-09-01 as the current block, plus T2026-1 and T2026. No public API was offered.

sources.title: T2026-2 chapter-by-chapter index
authoritative_for: Chapter and section titles and the effective date printed on each index row
sources.notes: Parsed into data/chapters.json. The parser refuses a file that is not chapters 1 through 99.

sources.title: Consolidated Customs Tariff
authoritative_for: The consolidated statute and its amendment list as published by Justice Laws
not_authoritative_for: The line-level schedule, which the CBSA departmental consolidation presents separately
sources.notes: Page said Act current to 2026-10-19 and last amended on 2026-09-01.

sources.title: United States Surtax Order (2026)
authoritative_for: The existence and consolidation currency of SOR/2026-186
sources.notes: Schedules were not ingested. Customs Notice 26-23 describes administration and is not the Order.

sources.title: Finance Canada counter-tariff list
authoritative_for: The Department of Finance's own statement of where it publishes the product list
not_authoritative_for: A rate copied into this repository
sources.notes: The page both calls itself the authoritative list and says the consolidated list has no official sanction. The table was left on the official page.

sources.title: CBSA guides, rulings pages, D-memoranda, and Customs Notices
authoritative_for: CBSA explanations of classification, rulings, and current notices that were actually opened
not_authoritative_for: Notices and memoranda that were not opened
sources.notes: Opened pages are the document records. The Customs Notices index says notices are not an ongoing reference.

sources.title: SIMA measures in force
authoritative_for: The CBSA's public list, subject to the finding or order
not_authoritative_for: A copied measure or a duty amount
sources.notes: The page says the finding or order takes precedence over the list.

sources.title: Global Affairs controls and agreements catalogue
authoritative_for: The public entry points for controls and the agreements catalogue
sources.notes: The agreements page says its treaty texts are informational and points readers to the Canada Treaty Series. CPTPP status for the United Kingdom conflicted with Customs Notice 26-22 on the day both were read.

sources.title: Canada Gazette
not_authoritative_for: An instrument that was not opened
sources.notes: Homepage reachability was checked. No Gazette corpus was downloaded.

sources.title: Canadian International Trade Tribunal
authoritative_for: The tribunal's public site as the place to read its decisions
not_authoritative_for: A case outcome stored in this project

sources.title: Departmental consolidation cover warning
authoritative_for: The warning printed on that PDF cover
not_authoritative_for: T2026-2 line rates. The cover that was read is labelled T2026(E), not T2026-2.
sources.notes: Cover text: prepared for convenience of reference only and, as such, has no official sanction. Catalogue No. PS35-7E-PDF.

sources.title: Commercial tariff APIs, including TradeFacts.io
not_authoritative_for: Any rate, classification, or citation in TariffWire
sources.notes: A commercial API may be convenient, but it is not the CBSA, Justice Laws, or the Canada Gazette. This project does not call one and does not treat one as authority.

sources.title: CBSA Assessment and Revenue Management (CARM) Client Portal
not_authoritative_for: This project. CARM is an authenticated operational system.
sources.notes: D11-11-3 and the BIS page describe CARM as a channel for trade accounts and ruling applications. TariffWire does not log in, scrape, or submit applications.

sources.title: WCO Harmonized System Explanatory Notes
sources.notes: The Explanatory Notes are not a free Canadian legal instrument and were not copied. Classification help in this project points to the Canadian Customs Tariff and the CBSA guide instead.
